about: Character creation event: a user's avatar was created. Written by bg3.exe+0x37913D0 on a new event entity; esv::StoryGameEventManager::OnUserAvatarCreated (Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0xEDE5C0) turns it into Osiris event 0xA2 with parameters (+0x10, +0, +8) - the story event UserAvatarCreated((INTEGER)_UserID, (CHARACTER)_Avatar, (CHARACTER)_Daisy) from the game's Osiris data (gatekit about UserAvatarCreated). Registered as a normal component although named OneFrame; the clean-up list bg3.exe+0x3797CF0 removes it together with CharacterSelectedForUser / CompanionSelectedForUser / CreationFinished. Never seen alive. Registry total 24 (server row).

evidence.says: Creator bg3.exe+0x3796550 (AllocRaw 0x18) writes 0xffc0000000000000 at +0; writer bg3.exe+0x37913D0 line 132 stores a character handle at +0. OnUserAvatarCreated passes HUB::Get(+0) as the 2nd Osiris parameter = _Avatar of the game's Osiris event UserAvatarCreated.

Creator writes 0xffc0000000000000 at +8; writer line 133 stores another character handle at +8 (from bg3.exe+0x3791C80, a second character). OnUserAvatarCreated passes HUB::Get(+8) as the 3rd parameter = _Daisy of the Osiris event.

Creator writes the global at bg3.exe+0x617CEAC (default UserID) at +0x10; writer line 131 copies a 4-byte value (the user id) to +0x10. OnUserAvatarCreated passes the dword at +0x10 as the 1st parameter = _UserID of the Osiris event.
